title: Lighting Delete x Cam x LeftClick function
features:
--This Script is copied and combie many scripts
-Simple Detele Lighting's Effects
-Simple CameraFunction
-Left Ctrl + Left Click to TP
-Left Shift + Left Click to Loop Anchor
-Left Alt + Left Click to Delete
script:
lightDel = {
	["Sky"] = true,
	["Atmosphere"] = true,
	["SunRaysEffect"] = true,
	["ColorCorrectionEffect"] = true,
	["BloomEffect"] = true,
	["BlurEffect"] = true,
}

task.spawn(function()
while true do
	light = game.Lighting:GetChildren()
	for _,i in ipairs(light) do
		if lightDel[i.ClassName] then
			i:Destroy()
		end
	end
	game.Lighting.FogEnd = 10000000
	game.Lighting.FogStart = 0
	task.wait(1)
end
end)

local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
task.spawn(function()
while true do
	plr.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 1000000000
	plr.DevCameraOcclusionMode = Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam
	task.wait(0.1)
end
end)

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = Player:GetMouse()


function GetCharacter()
   return game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
end

function Teleport(pos)
   local Char = GetCharacter()
   if Char then
       Char:MoveTo(pos)
   end
end


UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
   if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
       Teleport(Mouse.Hit.p)
   end
end)

local Plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Mouse = Plr:GetMouse()

Mouse.Button1Down:connect(function()
if not game:GetService("UserInputService"):IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt) then return end
if not Mouse.Target then return end
Mouse.Target:Destroy()
end)
--
local Plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Mouse = Plr:GetMouse()

Mouse.Button1Down:connect(function()
if not game:GetService("UserInputService"):IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then return end
	if not Mouse.Target then return end
		local part = Mouse.Target
		while true do
			part.Anchored = true
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
end)
--LCtrl + LClick to TP
--LShift + LClick to InfAnchor
--LAlt + LClick to Del
